verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents stream objects that record DML changes so actions can be taken on the changed data, which is core change-data-capture for incremental processing. It also lists Dynamic Tables as GA (a declarative pipeline construct) and offers dbt Projects to develop, deploy and orchestrate transformations inside the platform; Snowpipe adds continuous micro-batch ingestion, and a community user describes running incremental dbt models in Snowflake. missing for 10: no evidence of tasks or scheduling for consuming streams, only a bare release-note mention of Dynamic Tables with no description of refresh or incremental semantics, and no independent hands-on corroboration of streams or dynamic-table pipelines.
